metadata.model: Gradient-boosted decision trees (scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingClassifier, logistic loss)
metadata.predicts: how likely each species is to have at least one GBIF record in a state in a month
metadata.what_it_is_not: not a count of animals and not a probability for a household; a record is one report by a person
metadata.hyperparameters_note: fixed before any score was computed; not tuned on the test years

sources: Area of Permanent Forest Reserves by State, Forestry Department of Peninsular Malaysia and DOSM, data.gov.my, CC BY 4.0, hectares; latest year 2022, later years reuse 2022
dataset.retrieved_note: Date each raw file was saved in the project (file timestamps in the Iteration 3 package): iteration3_data_for_ML.csv, population_state.json and forest_reserve_state.csv, 30 September 2026.

metadata.data_last_month_available: 2026-08 (2025 and 2026 are incomplete because of release lag)
